items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Snooky, Marvin Stamm. [INTERVIEWEE] Snooky Young, probably Ernie Royal, and a bunch of other people on there.

ctx.x: Quincy was in the control room with Creed, because Creed produced that. Creed has always been a guy who – very subtle. He never talks directly to the musicians. He always had a liason, always, because he – I don’t know. Even during – he had a little red phone on the desk. He had a little black phone on the desk. He used the red phone for one thing and the black phone was another. I think the red phone you talk directly to the guy on the podium – I mean, I guess you call it the podium. Whoever the conductor was.…
Snooky Young, probably Ernie Royal, and a bunch of other people on there.
